episodes.title: Teen Killed in Osun Cult-Linked Shooting | Nigeria News
episodes.description:
A 19-year-old, Timileyin Oni, was fatally shot in Ijebu-Jesa, Osun State, late Monday night, sparking an urgent investigation into possible cult involvement after police received reports of gunfire. Three others were injured; Oni’s father claims he was attacked while returning from church. Authorities, citing prior warnings about cult activities around July 7, have deployed an anti-cult unit but no arrests have been made. Meanwhile, political blame games escalate—with the Accord Party accusing APC of orchestrating the violence, while APC denies any political motive, citing eyewitness accounts of motorcycle-mounted attackers. This is the latest in a pattern of partisan finger-pointing following violent incidents in the state.
